title: Disproportionate Voices: Participation Inequality and Hostile Engagement in News Comments

bias_targets.methodology: Classification of news comments into hate speech categories using a transformer-based deep learning model (KC-Electra) fine-tuned on the Korean UnSmile Dataset to detect hostility targeting race or nationality across different user activity groups.
